title: Peter Yuan, An Appeal to the Standing Judicial Commission of PCA Regarding Samuel Ling's Heresy
disposition_detail: The Standing Judicial Commission found Case 2010-06 administratively out of order.
first_summary: Peter Yuan appealed to the SJC regarding alleged heresy by Samuel Ling. The Commission found the appeal administratively out of order but reported no reason or further relief.
